text:
Sam (PM): Quick sync — I'm circling a PRD draft for the compliance/security scope for the next release. link: <https://redwood.internal/rfcs/345>. Need signoff on acceptance criteria + a minimal shipable surface.
Maria (Security): skimmed. main asks: audit logs (immutable), KMS integration, retention policy, SOC2 mapping. Also need threat-model notes for HSM vs KMS.
John (Eng): agree. HSM full integration is heavy. propose KMS first + HSM as enterprise add-on. That buys us a launch path.
Li (DevEx): from SDK/console side, we need clear config knobs: kms_key_id, retention_days, audit_export=true/false. defaults matter (secure-by-default).
Tara (Legal): retention defaults must match our Data Retention policy. 90 days is fine for hosted; enterprise can request custom retention via contract. Add a clause for regulatory holds.
Kevin (Customer): from a customer's POV: we need tamper-evident logs and proof of key separation. HSM waiver not acceptable for some banks. timeline matters.
Maria (Security): noted. acceptance checklist draft: 
- Audit logs: append-only, signed, exportable in NDJSON with schema v1. 
- KMS: envelope encryption for request payloads + per-customer keys.
- Retention: default 90d, admin override to X days (min 30).
- SOC2: map controls to our existing SOC2 matrix (link).
- HSM: roadmap item + documented contract requirement for enterprise.
John (Eng): edge cases: 
- cache/KV entries in memory — we must ensure no PII persisted in logs. redact before logging.
- partial failures during rotate-key — ensure requests fallback to previous key for 2h window.
- audit export while re-encrypting — must not lose events.
Li (DevEx): can we author a tiny RFC section with API examples? like: ```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "kms_key_id": "arn:...",
  "request": { ... }
}
```
ops-bot: Automated test run for rfc/345 completed — 18 checks passed, 3 warnings (retention policy conflation).
Sam (PM): good callouts. Proposed launch criteria (must meet all): 
- Core: KMS+audit-logs with export, retention default=90d, redaction rules enforced.
- Security signoff: Maria + Ops review.
- Legal signoff for retention/contract language.
- E2E smoke: canary with 2 Dedicated customers.
Maria (Security): gating: we will not certify for SOC2 control unless audit logs are immutable and HSM requirements are documented (even if HSM not in M1).
Tara (Legal): add 'regulatory hold' flow: preserve logs beyond retention when flagged. Need acceptance test.
John (Eng): implementation notes: reuse existing audit pipeline (kafka -> s3 immutable bucket) but add signing step (sigv4-like). We need perf tests for signing latency.
Kevin (Customer): can you capture an enterprise path that says: if HSM required, delivery timeline 3-6 months and custom pricing. That'll set expectations.
Sam (PM): will update PRD with all that. Action items: 
- Maria: finalize redaction & signing requirements (due +3 days).
- John: perf/rotate-key design (due +5 days).
- Li: SDK options + examples (due +4 days).
- Tara: contract language & reg-hold flow (due +5 days).
- Sam: update PRD and post for review.
Maria (Security): one more edge: auditors sometimes ask for raw SSL traces. we should pre-define what we will not provide and how to provide derived evidence. add to RFC.
Sam (PM): noted. thanks everyone. I'll post updated PRD tomorrow and ping @eng-runtime + @customer-success for canary picks. :thumbsup:
